mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_decision_advice (alert_id, car_id, alert_type, source, model, risk_level, summary, risk_explanation, recommendations, allowed_actions, raw_response, fallback_reason, review_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{alertId}, #{carId}, #{alertType}, #{source}, #{model}, #{riskLevel}, #{summary}, #{riskExplanation}, #{recommendations}, #{allowedActions}, #{rawResponse}, #{fallbackReason}, #{reviewStatus}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, alert_id AS alertId, car_id AS carId, alert_type AS alertType, source, model, risk_level AS riskLevel, summary, risk_explanation AS riskExplanation, recommendations, allowed_actions AS allowedActions, raw_response AS rawResponse, fallback_reason AS fallbackReason, review_status AS reviewStatus, reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, review_comment AS reviewComment, reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_decision_advice WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, alert_id AS alertId, car_id AS carId, alert_type AS alertType, source, model, risk_level AS riskLevel, summary, risk_explanation AS riskExplanation, recommendations, allowed_actions AS allowedActions, raw_response AS rawResponse, fallback_reason AS fallbackReason, review_status AS reviewStatus, reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, review_comment AS reviewComment, reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_decision_advice WHERE alert_id = #{alertId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_decision_advice SET review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
